'''Murmurstown''' is an area of {{Location|Sanguis Plateaus}}. Before it fell to the [[Dark Tide]] sixteen years ago, Murmurstown was called Fabianum. It was the hometown of [[Augusta]] and [[Galbrena|Angel]] who are the only survivors of the Dark Tide.

The people of the former town were turned into [[Dark Tide#Effects and Properties|Hollow Figures]], their minds twisted by the Dark Tide and their corpses raised as mindless puppets.
